sql: SELECT p.id,p.goods_id,p.number,p.price,p.specifications,g.name FROM litemall_goods_product p JOIN litemall_goods g ON g.id=p.goods_id WHERE p.deleted=0 AND g.deleted=0 AND g.is_on_sale=1 AND p.number>=5 ORDER BY p.id LIMIT 1
